sops.title: PK Chunking failure recovery
sops.body: If batch job fails with PK Chunking timeout: 1) Set PKCHUNK=N in JCL PARMS 2) Re-submit job 3) Verify CC 0000 4) Restore PKCHUNK=Y for next cycle. HITL required before submit.
